# Vermont Wins Big at Sixth GTA Awards.
By: Timothy Golubowski \
Last Updated: 11/6/2026

---
***Last *** month in Vice City Florida, the sixth annual GTA, Greatest Transit Awards, were held in the Hyman Memorial Stadium, and over five thousand transit and energy officials came from around the country, and braved winds and rain from tropical storm Tommy to attend the nations most popular transit convention. 

## Big Winners of the Night 
Vermont and New Jersey won two of the biggest, yet contrasting awards. The Green Mountain Transit Authority from Vermont won the Greenest Transit Award coming in first with the least emissions of carbon dioxide per passenger mile and least emission of carbon dioxide per UPT.  

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Data Loading and calculations for this release.

For the greatest transparency to our readers, we always include our figures and methodology. You can find the R scripts neccesary for this press release here, along with scripts for specific tasks done during the exploratory data analysis phase of writing this rlease

```{r}
#| label: State Electricity Profiles
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: Loading data from State Electricity Profiles Task 1a

library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(httr2)
library(rvest)

get_eia_sep <- function(state, abbr){
    library(tidyverse)
    library(stringr)
    library(httr2)
    library(rvest)
    library(fs)
  
    state_formatted <- str_to_lower(state) |> str_replace_all("\\s", "")
    
    dir_name <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
    file_name <- fs::path(dir_name, state_formatted)
    
    fs::dir_create(dir_name, recurse=TRUE)
    
    if(!fs::file_exists(file_name)){
        BASE_URL <- "https://www.eia.gov"
        RESPONSE <- request(BASE_URL) |> 
          req_url_path("electricity", 
                       "state", 
                       state_formatted) |>
          req_headers(
            `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0"
            ) |>   
          req_retry(
                max_tries = 4, 
          ) |>
          req_perform(file_name)
    
        resp_check_status(RESPONSE)
    }
    
    page <- read_html(file_name)
    tbl  <- html_element(page, "table")

    if (inherits(tbl, "xml_missing")) {
      fs::file_delete(file_name)   
      stop("No table found for ", state, ". Cached file removed; re-run.")
      Sys.sleep(1)
}

TABLE <- tbl |> 
    html_table() |>
    mutate(Item = str_to_lower(Item))
    
    TABLE <- read_html(file_name) |> 
        html_element("table") |> 
        html_table() |>
        mutate(Item = str_to_lower(Item))
    
    if("U.S. rank" %in% colnames(TABLE)){
        TABLE <- TABLE |> rename(Rank = `U.S. rank`)
    }
    
    CO2_MWh <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "carbon dioxide (lbs/mwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |> 
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    PRIMARY <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "primary energy source") |> 
        pull(Rank)
    
    RATE <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "average retail price (cents/kwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        as.numeric()
    
    GENERATION_MWh <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "net generation (megawatthours)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    data.frame(CO2_MWh               = CO2_MWh, 
               primary_source        = PRIMARY,
               electricity_price_MWh = RATE * 10, # / 100 cents to dollars &
               # * 1000 kWh to MWH 
               generation_MWh        = GENERATION_MWh, 
               state                 = state, 
               abbreviation          = abbr
              
    )
}

EIA_SEP_REPORT <- map2(state.name, state.abb, get_eia_sep) |> list_rbind()
```

```{r}
#| label: Energy Consumption
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary:  Loading 2025 Annual Database Energy Consumption report. Task 1b


load_ntd_energy <- function(){
  library(readxl)
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_ENERGY_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_energy.xlsx")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://www.transit.dot.gov/") |>
      req_url_path("sites",
                   "fta.dot.gov",
                   "files",
                   "2026-09",
                   "2025 Energy Consumption_260806.xlsx") |> 
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Energy File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_energy.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  to_numeric_fill_0 <- function(x){
    x <- if_else(x == "-", NA, x)
    replace_na(as.numeric(x), 0)
  }

  read_excel(NTD_ENERGY_FILE) |> 
    select(-c(`Reporter Type`, 
              `Reporting Module`, 
              `Gallons of Other Fuel`, 
              `Other Fuel Description`)) |>
    mutate(across(-c(`Agency Name`, 
                     `Mode`,
                     `TOS`), 
                  to_numeric_fill_0)) |>
    group_by(`NTD ID`, `Mode`, `Agency Name`) |>
    summarize(across(where(is.numeric), sum), 
              .groups = "keep") |>
    mutate(ENERGY = sum(c_across(c(where(is.numeric))))) |>
    filter(ENERGY > 0) |>
    select(-ENERGY) |>
    ungroup()
}

NTD_ENERGY <- load_ntd_energy()
```

```{r}
#| label: NTD Service Load
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary:  Loading NTD Service Load Report Task 1c

load_ntd_service <- function(){
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_SERVICE_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_service.csv")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://data.transportation.gov/resource/4fir-qbim.csv") |>
      req_url_query(`$query`=paste(
        "SELECT  `_5_digit_ntd_id` AS `NTD_ID`", 
        "`max_agency` AS `AGENCY`",
        "`max_reporter_type` AS `reporter_type`",
        "`max_organization_type` AS `organization_type`",
        "`max_city` AS `city`",
        "`max_state` AS `state`",
        "`mode`",
        "`type_of_service`",
        "`max_primary_uza_code` as `uza_code`",
        "`max_primary_uza_name` as `uza_name`",
        "`max_primary_uza_area_sq_miles` as `uza_sq_miles`",
        "`max_primary_uza_population` as `uza_population`",
        "`max_service_area_sq_miles` as `service_area_sq_miles`",
        "`max_service_area_population` as `service_area_population`",
        "`questionable_record` as `flagged_likely_inaccurate`",
        "`sum_unlinked_passenger_trips_upt` + `sum_ada_upt` + `sum_sponsored_service_upt` as `total_upt`",
        "`sum_passenger_miles` WHERE caseless_one_of(`report_year`, '2025') limit 50000", 
        sep=",")) |>
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Service File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_service.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  read_csv(NTD_SERVICE_FILE) |>
    mutate(flagged_likely_inaccurate = !is.na(flagged_likely_inaccurate))
}

NTD_SERVICE <- load_ntd_service()


```

```{r}
#| label: Calculate Emissions
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary:  Emissions Calculation Task 5

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)



EIA_SEP_REPORT <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |>
  rename(state_abbreviation = abbreviation)

NTD_SERVICE <- NTD_SERVICE |> 
  rename(state_abbreviation = state)



sevice_eia_join <- left_join(NTD_SERVICE, EIA_SEP_REPORT, by = join_by(state_abbreviation)) 
  
sevice_eia_join <- sevice_eia_join |> mutate(NTD_ID = as.double(NTD_ID))

NTD_ENERGY <- NTD_ENERGY |> 
  rename(NTD_ID = `NTD ID`)

service_energy_eia <- left_join(sevice_eia_join, NTD_ENERGY, by = join_by(NTD_ID))


service_energy_eia <- service_energy_eia |>
  mutate(CO2_emissions = (CO2_MWh * generation_MWh) + (`Gallons of Bio-Diesel` * 22.45) + (`Gallons of Bunker Fuel` * 22.45 ) + (`Gallons of Compressed Natural Gas` * 16.30 ) + (`Gallons of Diesel Fuel` * 22.45) + (`Gallons of Ethanol` * 12.70) + (`Gallons of Gasoline` * 20.86) + (`Gallons of Kerosene` * 21.78) + (`Gallons of Liquified Nat Gas` * 9.90 ) + (`Gallons of Liquified Petroleum Gas` * 12.68))


```

```{r}
#| label: Transit Usage
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary:  Transit and Emission relationship Task 6

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)

service_energy_eia_no_na <- service_energy_eia |> #I had very stubborn NAs 
  filter(!is.na(total_upt)) |>
  filter(!is.na(CO2_emissions))
  
         
#passenger miles and agency emissions in seperate tables and then joined & judged 
upt_by_agency <- service_energy_eia_no_na |> 
  filter(!is.na(total_upt)) |>
  distinct(AGENCY, type_of_service, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  group_by(AGENCY) |>
  filter(!is.na(total_upt)) |>
  summarise(sum_upt = sum(total_upt, NA.rm = TRUE))

emissions_by_agency <- service_energy_eia_no_na |>
  filter(!is.na(CO2_emissions)) |>
  group_by(AGENCY) |>
  summarise(sum_emissions = sum(CO2_emissions, NA.rm =TRUE))

per_upt <- emissions_by_agency |>
  left_join(upt_by_agency, by = "AGENCY") |>
  mutate(emissions_per_upt = sum_emissions / sum_upt) |>
  mutate(
  efficiency_rating = case_when(
    emissions_per_upt <= quantile(emissions_per_upt, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "More efficient",
    emissions_per_upt >= quantile(emissions_per_upt, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Less efficient",
    !is.na(emissions_per_upt) ~ "Average"
  )
)

#passenger miles and agency emissions in seperate tables and then joined & judged 
passenger_mile_by_agency <- service_energy_eia_no_na |>
  filter(!is.na(sum_passenger_miles)) |>
  distinct(AGENCY, type_of_service, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  group_by(AGENCY) |>
  filter(!is.na(sum_passenger_miles)) |>
  summarise(total_passenger_miles = sum(sum_passenger_miles, NA.rm = TRUE))

emissions_by_agency <- service_energy_eia_no_na |>
  filter(!is.na(CO2_emissions)) |>
  group_by(AGENCY) |>
  summarise(sum_emissions = sum(CO2_emissions, NA.rm =TRUE))

per_passenger_miles <- emissions_by_agency |>
  left_join(passenger_mile_by_agency, by = "AGENCY") |>
  mutate(emissions_per_passenger_mile = sum_emissions / total_passenger_miles) |>
  mutate(
  efficiency_rating = case_when(
    emissions_per_passenger_mile <= quantile(emissions_per_passenger_mile, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "More efficient",
    emissions_per_passenger_mile >= quantile(emissions_per_passenger_mile, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Less efficient",
    !is.na(emissions_per_passenger_mile) ~ "Average"
  )
)
```

```{r}
print(print_plot_greenest_transit)
```

While the New Jersey Transit Corporation won the Worst of Fuel Consumption award, due to the NJTC insatiable thirst for fuel. The spokesperson for the NJTC, Niko Belic, said in a statement "We are getting quenched every year ... we hope to cut this number in half by 2030". 

```{r}
#| label: Worst of Fuel Consumption Graph
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: Top Fuel Consumers

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

fuel_cols <- c("Gallons of Bio-Diesel", "Gallons of Bunker Fuel",
               "Gallons of Compressed Natural Gas", "Gallons of Diesel Fuel",
               "Gallons of Ethanol", "Gallons of Gasoline",
               "Gallons of Kerosene", "Gallons of Liquified Nat Gas",
               "Gallons of Liquified Petroleum Gas")


make_acronym <- function(x) {
  stop_words <- c("of", "the", "and", "for", "in", "a", "dba")
  vapply(strsplit(x, "[^A-Za-z0-9]+"), function(w) {
    w <- w[w != "" & !tolower(w) %in% stop_words]
    paste0(ifelse(w == toupper(w) & nchar(w) > 1, w, substr(w, 1, 1)),
           collapse = "")
  }, character(1))
}

manual_abbr <- c(
  # "MTA New York City Transit" = "NYCT"
)

agency_fuel <- NTD_ENERGY |>
  filter(Mode != "Unknown") |>
  mutate(total_fuel = rowSums(pick(all_of(fuel_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(`Agency Name`) |>
  summarise(total_fuel = sum(total_fuel, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(total_fuel)) |>
  mutate(abbr = make_acronym(`Agency Name`),
         abbr = coalesce(unname(manual_abbr[`Agency Name`]), abbr),
         abbr = make.unique(abbr),   # avoids two agencies sharing an acronym
         highlight = row_number() == 1)

top_share    <- agency_fuel$total_fuel[1] / sum(agency_fuel$total_fuel)
times_second <- agency_fuel$total_fuel[1] / agency_fuel$total_fuel[2]

plot_df <- slice_head(agency_fuel, n = 10)

plot_worst_of <- ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = reorder(abbr, -total_fuel),
           y = total_fuel / 1e6,
           fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(total_fuel / 1e6, 3)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "dodgerblue4", "FALSE" = "lightsteelblue3"),
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Transit Authority", y = "Gallons (millions)",
       title = "The #1 Fuel Consumer Dwarfs the Rest",
       subtitle = sprintf("%s uses %.1f%% of all fuel and %.1fx the #2 agency",
                          plot_df$abbr[1], top_share * 100, times_second),
       caption = paste0(plot_df$abbr[1], " = ", plot_df$`Agency Name`[1])) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

print(plot_worst_of)

```


## But What Do These Awards Mean? 

### Greenest transit Award
The Greenest Transit award is given to the transit agency with the smallest emissions, pounds of CO2 released, per passenger boarding of a public transit vehicle referred to as a Unlinked Passenger Trip or UPT, and per passenger miles, total volume of service consumed by riders. The CO2 emissions are tabulated from the [NTD Service Report](https://www.transit.dot.gov/ntd) and the [EIA Carbon Dioxide Emissions Coefficients](https://www.eia.gov/environment/emissions/co2_vol_mass.php). The gallons of used fuel are multiplied by carbon dioxide emissions coefficients, and totaled together with all other fuel sources used. 

### Worst of Fuel Consumption Award
The Worst of Fuel Consumption award is given to the transit Agency that consumes the most fuel out of all transit agencies that were tracked in the [NTD Energy Report](https://www.transit.dot.gov/ntd/data-product/2024-annual-database-energy-consumption).


### Looking forward
Although the sixth GTA has just ended, pundits have already been making thier predictions for the next which has already been confirmed for the Liberty Memorial Coliseum in Liberty City. All we can do now is wait and see who wins the next awards. 

-Timothy Golubowski, transportation staff writer for Vice City News

```{r}
    across(where(is.numeric), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "fuel_type", values_to = "gallons") |>
  mutate(fuel_type = sub("Gallons of ", "", fuel_type)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(fuel_type, -gallons), y = gallons / 1e6)) +
  geom_col(fill = "dodgerblue4") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(gallons / 1e6, 3)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Fuel type", y = "Gallons (millions)",
       title = "Total Fuel Consumption by Type") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

print(most_fuel_consumed_plot)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

least_common_fuel_source <- NTD_ENERGY |>
  select(-c(`Bio-Diesel Description`, `Kilograms of Hydrogen`, `Kilowatt hours of Electric Propulsion`, `Kilowatt hours of Electric Battery`, NTD_ID)) |>

  arrange(gallons) |>
  slice_head(n = 1)

cat("The least common fuel source is",as.character(least_common_fuel_source[1, 1]), " with only", as.numeric(least_common_fuel_source[1, 2]), "gallons being used.")
```

```{r}
#| label: Data Intergration
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary:  Initial Table Joining Task 4

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)


#EIA_SEP_REPORT <- EIA_SEP_REPORT |> rename(state_abbreviation = abbreviation)
#NTD_SERVICE <- NTD_SERVICE |> rename(state_abbreviation = state)
#NTD_ENERGY <- NTD_ENERGY|> rename(NTD_ID = `NTD ID`)


sevice_eia_join <- left_join(NTD_SERVICE, EIA_SEP_REPORT, by = join_by(state_abbreviation))
sevice_eia_join <- sevice_eia_join |> mutate(NTD_ID = as.double(NTD_ID))

service_energy_eia <- left_join(sevice_eia_join, NTD_ENERGY, by = join_by(NTD_ID))

nuculear_upt <- service_energy_eia |> 
  filter(primary_source == "Nuclear") |>
  summarise(Nuclear_UPTs = sum(total_upt, na.rm = TRUE))

nuculear_upt |> gt() |>
  cols_label(Nuclear_UPTs = md("Number of UPTs in States With Nuclear Energy"))

most_bio_diesel_metro <- service_energy_eia |>
  arrange(desc(`Gallons of Bio-Diesel`)) |>
  dplyr::select(uza_name) |>
  head(n = 1)
  

most_bio_diesel_metro |> 
  gt() |>
  cols_label(uza_name = md("Area with Greatest Consumption of Bio Diesel (in gallons)"))

```
